title: Budgeted Multi-Source Counterfactual Annotation for Off-Policy Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.10974v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value of a target policy from logged data, but limited behavior-policy coverage can force high-variance reweighting or reward-model extrapolation. Counterfactual annotations can add evidence about unobserved actions, yet practical sources, including domain experts and large language models (LLMs), may be costly, biased, or noisy. We study budgeted acquisition of such annotations for contextual-bandit OPE. Given source-specific costs and error profiles, we formulate an integer allocation problem over context-action pairs and annotation sources to minimize the component of estimator variance that depends on the annotation plan. We characterize when annotations are valuable through a first-annotation threshold and local annotation-value regimes. translated_title: 预算约束下面向离线策略评估的多源反事实标注
translated_abstract: 离线策略评估（OPE）旨在从记录数据中估计目标策略的价值，但行为策略有限的覆盖范围可能迫使使用高方差的重新加权或奖励模型外推。反事实标注可以补充关于未观测动作的证据，然而实际的标注来源（包括领域专家和大语言模型）可能成本高昂、存在偏差或噪声。我们研究了在上下文多臂老虎机离线策略评估中预算约束下的此类标注获取问题。给定各来源特有的成本和误差特征，我们在上下文-动作对与标注来源上构建了一个整数分配问题，以最小化估计器方差中依赖于标注方案的分量。我们通过“首次标注阈值”和局部标注价值区间刻画了标注何时具有价值。针对耦合的多源问题，我们开发了一种带有动态规划子程序的主要化-最小化算法，该算法能够单调地改进解的质量。
tldr: 该论文提出了预算约束下面向离线策略评估的多源反事实标注获取框架，将标注分配建模为整数规划问题，通过带动态规划子程序的主要化-最小化算法求解以最小化估计器方差，并刻画了标注产生价值的阈值条件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a budgeted multi-source counterfactual annotation acquisition framework for off-policy evaluation, formulating an integer allocation problem solved via a majorization-minimization algorithm with dynamic-programming subroutines to minimize estimator variance, and characterizes when annotations become valuable through a first-annotation threshold.
